title: Removal From Service Special Powers Second Amendment Ordinance 2003

sections.shortTitle: Removal From Service Special Powers Second Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
REMOVAL FROM
SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
ORDINANCE II OF 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Removal
from Service
(Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
16th May, 2003]
F.No.2(I)/2003-Pub, dated
16-5-2003.----The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Removal from Service
(Special Powers) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Removal From Service Special Powers Second Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XVII of 2000

REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
REMOVAL FROM
SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
ORDINANCE II OF 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Removal
from Service
(Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
16th May, 2003]
F.No.2(I)/2003-Pub, dated
16-5-2003.----The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XVII of 2000.---In the Removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000 (XVII of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance,
in section 2,---
(a) clause (a)
shall be omitted; and
(b) in clause
(aa), for the words "Chief Executive", occurring twice, the words
"Prime Minister" shall be substituted.

F.No.2(I)/2003-Pub, dated

published for general information:---
3. Amendment of section 9,
Ordinance XVII of 2000.-----In the said Ordinance, in section 9,--
(a) in
subsection (1), for the words "Chief Executive", occurring thrice,
the words "Prime Minister" shall be substituted; and
(b) in
subsection (2), for the words "Chief Executive", occurring twice, the
words "Prime Minister" shall be substituted.
